description: Use to fill a text field: appends any text (Korean, emoji included) to the focused field through the on-device helper; into = text or resource-id of the field to tap first. Returns the field typed into and the new screen outline (screen:false to skip). Without the helper it falls back to `input text`, where non-ASCII fails with the reason.

screen.description: false = do not return the new screen

name: type
